comments.en: Scenario 503 — FreeSql Multi-Table and Advanced Terminal:

comments.zh: 双表 JOIN 投影 / IncludeMany 一对多导航 / ToChunkDtoAsync 异步分批 /
comments.en: Dual-table JOIN projection / IncludeMany one-to-many navigation / ToChunkDtoAsync asynchronous chunked retrieval /

comments.zh: ToLookup 分组 / Fluent DTO 投影。全部内存 SQLite 形态，不依赖外部数据库。
comments.en: ToLookup grouping / Fluent DTO projection. Entirely in-memory SQLite mode, no external database dependency.

comments.zh: 双表 JOIN 投影：ISelect<T1, T2> + LeftJoin + AsDto → SQL 侧完成 JOIN 与列裁剪。
comments.en: Dual-table JOIN projection: ISelect<T1, T2> + LeftJoin + AsDto → JOIN and column projection executed entirely on the SQL side.

comments.zh: 跨表字段（CatalogName）由 [MapProperty(typeof(CatalogEntity), ...)] 声明取数来源。
comments.en: Cross-table field (CatalogName) is declared via [MapProperty(typeof(CatalogEntity), ...)] to specify its data source.

comments.zh: Assert: row count after JOIN = product count, and cross-table fields are non-empty (failure -> Error Summary -> exit code 1)
comments.en: Assertion: Number of rows after JOIN equals the number of Products, and cross-table fields are non-null (failure → Error Summary → exit code 1).

comments.zh: 一对多导航集合投影：IncludeMany(c => c.Products) 先加载子表集合，
comments.en: One-to-many navigation collection projection: IncludeMany(c => c.Products) first loads the child-table collection.

comments.zh: AsDto 后导航集合逐元素走 CatalogProductEntity → CatalogProductDto 同名映射（嵌套集合非空）。
comments.en: After AsDto, each element in the navigation collection undergoes CatalogProductEntity → CatalogProductDto mapping by property name (nested collection must be non-empty).

comments.zh: Assert: nested collections non-empty with correct content (Electronics catalog 3 items, Books catalog 1 item)
comments.en: Assertion: Nested collection is non-empty and contains correct content (3 electronics items, 1 book item).

comments.zh: 异步分批读取：ToChunkDtoAsync 真异步实现——逐页 Skip/Take + ToListAsync(ct)，
comments.en: Asynchronous chunked retrieval: ToChunkDtoAsync implements true asynchrony—per-page Skip/Take followed by ToListAsync(ct).

comments.zh: 每轮取数前检查取消令牌。分批读取要求**稳定排序**（OrderBy）作为分页前提，
comments.en: Cancellation token is checked before each round of data retrieval. Chunked retrieval requires **stable sorting** (OrderBy) as a prerequisite for pagination.

comments.zh: 否则各页边界在无序结果集上不可复现。
comments.en: Otherwise, page boundaries become unreproducible over an unsorted result set.

comments.zh: <param name="fsql">FreeSql 实例（已播种商品）</param>
comments.en: <param name="fsql">FreeSql instance (with seeded Product data)</param>

comments.zh: stable ordering is the prerequisite of chunked reading
comments.en: Stable sorting is a prerequisite for chunked retrieval.

comments.zh: Assert: 4 rows at 2 per batch = 2 batches, total count conserved
comments.en: Assertion: 4 total records split into chunks of size 2 yield exactly 2 chunks, preserving total count.

comments.zh: 分组查找表：ToLookup 按 keySelector 分组并批量映射 DTO
comments.en: Grouping lookup table: ToLookup groups by keySelector and maps DTOs in bulk.

comments.en: After source generator registration, AsDto performs per-declaration translation evaluation (purely translatable declarations → SQL-side projection).
